policy: A book is exportable only when its content hash appears here with status 'cleared_public_domain' and exportable true. Clearance under this policy means: the author died more than 70 years ago, the extracted text is a nineteenth-century or early twentieth-century edition, no copyright notice or modern editorial matter appears in the text, and any modern names in the file are digitisation credits rather than authorship claims. This is an engineering clearance for internal research, not a legal opinion. Legal review remains required before any redistribution or commercial use.
